units.source_text: 二女公子与住在山庄中时大不相同，深居帘内，非常舒服。

en.t: The Second Princess was quite different from when she had lived at the mountain villa; now she stayed deep behind the blinds and was very comfortable.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言从帘影里窥见一个可爱的女童，便叫她向二女公子传达消息。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, glimpsed a pretty young maid in the shadow of the blinds and asked her to carry a message to the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 帘内就送出一个坐垫来。

en.t: From within the blinds, a cushion was promptly sent out.

units.source_text: 有一侍女，大约是知道前情的人，出来传达二女公子的答话。

en.t: One lady-in-waiting, apparently someone who knew the earlier circumstances, came out and conveyed the Second Princess's reply.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言说：“相处甚近，本可朝夕相见，无所隔阂。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, said, "Living so near, we ought to be able to see each other morning and evening, with nothing between us.

units.source_text: 但无甚要事而常来访问，太过亲密，深恐遭人责咎，为此逡巡不前。

en.t: But if I visited often without any important reason, it would seem too intimate, and I deeply feared being blamed by others, so I hesitated to come forward.

units.source_text: 但觉曾几何时，世间景象已大异于昔。

en.t: Yet it feels as though, in no time at all, the whole world has become utterly different from the past.

units.source_text: 隔着春云遥望贵院庭中树木，不胜感慨之情。”

en.t: Looking from afar through the spring clouds at the trees in your residence's garden, I cannot contain my emotion."

units.source_text: 其忧愁苦恨之色，深可怜悯。

en.t: The sorrow and suffering in his expression made him deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 二女公子想道：“真可惜啊，如果姐姐在世，住在三条邸中，我们便可随时往还。

en.t: The Second Princess thought, "How sad it is; if my elder sister were alive and living at the Sanjo residence, we could visit each other whenever we wished.

units.source_text: 每逢春秋佳节，共赏花香鸟语，日子也可过得快乐些。”

en.t: At every lovely season in spring and autumn, we could enjoy the fragrance of flowers and the songs of birds together, and our days might have been happier."

units.source_text: 她回思往昔，觉得现在虽迁京都，却比从前长年忍受寂寞而闭居山庄中时更加悲伤，真乃遗憾无穷。

en.t: Thinking back on the past, she felt that although she had now moved to the capital, she was even sadder than when she had endured years of loneliness shut away in the mountain villa, and her regret was endless.

units.source_text: 众侍女也都来劝请：“这位中纳言大人，小姐不可像普通一般人那样疏慢他。

en.t: All the ladies-in-waiting also came to urge her, saying, "My lady, you must not treat this Middle Counselor lightly, as though he were an ordinary person.

units.source_text: 他过去无限忠诚之心，小姐当然知道，现在正该对他表示感谢了。”

en.t: You surely know the boundless devotion he has shown in the past, and now is exactly the time to show him your gratitude."

units.source_text: 但二女公子觉得不用侍女传言而贸然出去和他直接见面，毕竟不好意思。

en.t: But the Second Princess felt that it would still be embarrassing to go out rashly and meet him directly without sending word through a lady-in-waiting.

units.source_text: 正在此时，匂亲王因欲出门，进来向二女公子道别。

en.t: Just then, Prince Niou, about to go out, came in to say farewell to the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 他打扮得非常华丽，容姿实甚可观。

en.t: He was dressed with great splendor, and his appearance was truly striking.

units.source_text: 他望见薰中纳言坐在帘外，便对二女公子说道：“为何如此疏远，让他坐在帘外？

en.t: Seeing Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, seated outside the blinds, he said to the Second Princess, "Why keep him at such a distance and leave him sitting outside the blinds?

units.source_text: 他对你关怀无微不至，异乎寻常。

en.t: His concern for you is unusually careful and complete.

units.source_text: 我常恐他不怀好意。

en.t: I often fear that he may have improper intentions.

units.source_text: 然而过分疏远他，毕竟是罪过的。

en.t: Even so, keeping him too far away would, after all, be unkind.

units.source_text: 你请他进来，和他谈谈旧事吧。”

en.t: Invite him in and talk with him about old times."

units.source_text: 接着又改口说道：“虽然如此，对他过分随意不拘，亦非所宜。

en.t: Then he changed his tone and said, "Still, it would not be proper to be too casual and unreserved with him.

units.source_text: 此人心底里恐有可疑之处。”

en.t: There may be something suspicious hidden in this man's heart."

units.source_text: 二女公子见他言语反复，颇感厌烦。

en.t: The Second Princess found his shifting words rather tiresome.

units.source_text: 但她自己心中想道：“此人过去对我们关怀深切，现在不可疏慢了他。

en.t: But in her own heart she thought, "This man cared deeply for us in the past, and now I must not neglect him.

units.source_text: 他也曾说过：叫我把他看作亡姐的替身而亲近他。

en.t: He once said, too, that I should think of him as a substitute for my late sister and be close to him.

units.source_text: 我也希望有机会向他表示此心才好。”

en.t: I, too, wish I might have a chance to show him these feelings."

units.source_text: 然而匂亲王常常疑神疑鬼，说长道短，使她颇感痛苦。

en.t: Yet Prince Niou was always suspicious and full of remarks, which caused her considerable distress.
